when: scope, schedule, rights or feasibility changes

may_require: Feasibility Ledger with brief ceiling, line items or planning ranges that reconcile exactly to the total, contingency, specialized resources, schedule and approval milestones, and scope-reduction rule
planning allocations labeled as estimates or ranges rather than fabricated supplier quotations
may_veto: budget envelope whose line items or planning ranges do not reconcile to the stated total
specialized resource without a budget line and timeline milestone
cannot_authorize: legal clearance, license, consent or contract
on-set safety certification or medical judgment

required: What scope is removed first if the reconciled total exceeds the ceiling while preserving the core mechanism?
What dependency can stop the project?
Which specialized resource must appear in both budget and timeline?
Which unknown needs a test rather than contingency?
adaptive: What new evidence would change this recommendation?

diversity_checks: compare at least two regions when the question is not culturally local
retrieve a counterexample or failed alternative
separate award visibility from evidentiary strength

acceptance_criteria: brief ceiling is explicit and line items or planning ranges reconcile exactly to it
every specialized resource is represented in budget and schedule
planning allocation is distinguished from an actual supplier quotation
approval, capture, post, accessibility and delivery milestones form a critical path
scope-reduction rule protects the core mechanism when the account does not close

human_only: consent, welfare and representation approval by affected people
safety_escalations: any physical risk without qualified coordinator
legal_or_rights_escalations: any essential right without owner, territory, term and status

failure_conditions: planning allocation omitted to avoid false precision
budget envelope not reconciled to ceiling
specialized resource omitted from budget or timeline
risk hidden to protect creative route
